title: Reviews
description: View ratings and reviews left by customers.

help.title: About Reviews
help.overview: A marketplace review is the customer's rating and comment on a completed order. It belongs to the order and its listing, and feeds the listing's average rating and review count and the provider's reputation.

sections.title: Who can review
items: Only the order's customer, only once the order is completed, and only once per order.
Listing and reviewer are set by the server from the order and the caller.
Customers can also review from their storefront account, where completed orders without a review are offered.

sections.title: What it changes
items: The listing's average rating and review count are recomputed from its live reviews.
The provider profile shows the average rating across all their orders, from listings and task requests alike.

sections.title: Moderation
items: Reviews are not edited after they are written.
Only an administrator can delete a review; deleting is a soft delete and restoring brings the rating back.
